prd.title: Inbox Detail
prd.overview: Inbox Detail is the operator's per-incident workspace. Three-column layout (240px InboxRail / flex DetailPane / 360px EventChain) per locked #5. The center pane hosts structured per-decision reasoning capture (path picker → path-dependent fields, never single textarea) and the load-bearing single-click Submit verify + assign that fires four downstream events atomically (Verified + Assigned + CitizenAckInProgress + TechnicianDispatched). Single-click verify reuses web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts. This page is the structural answer to Goal 1.2 (verify + assign in < 60s).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/InboxDetail.tsx (904 LOC) to three-column layout; structured reasoning; single-click submit firing 4-event batch; secondary defer + escalate actions

requirement.title: Three-column layout (240 / flex / 360)
requirement.description: Render three-column layout: left 240px InboxRail, center flex DetailPane, right 360px EventChain. Proportions locked at 240/flex/360 per locked #5.

acceptance.criterion: InboxRail column is 240px wide
EventChain column is 360px wide
DetailPane flex-fills remaining space

requirement.title: InboxRail ranked list with band + reporter chips
requirement.description: Left rail renders ranked incidents with BandPill (glyph + text), reporter-badge chip, age, missing-evidence chips. Active incident highlighted.

acceptance.criterion: Each rail entry has band + reporter chips
Active incident visually distinguished

requirement.title: DetailPane composition (band + reporter + 5 signal cards + photo + map)
requirement.description: Center pane renders: BandPill, reporter-badge chip, missing-evidence chips, five verification signal cards, photo viewer + EXIF strip, map (incident marker + nearest sensor).

acceptance.criterion: Five signal cards render in order
Photo viewer + EXIF strip renders
Map shows incident marker + nearest sensor pin

requirement.title: Structured reasoning capture (path picker → fields)
requirement.description: Path picker renders A/B/C/D options. Selected path reveals path-dependent reasoning fields (severity / category / tags / reasoning text). Never single textarea; never free-form-only input. Per foundation §12 #7.

acceptance.criterion: Path picker renders A/B/C/D
Selected path reveals correct subset of structured fields
No single textarea for reasoning capture (verified by DOM inspection)

requirement.title: Single-click Submit verify + assign (4-event batch)
requirement.description: Single Submit button click fires four downstream events atomically in one batch POST /api/events: Verified{actor, incident_id, path, reasoning} + Assigned{actor, incident_id, to: karim_id, due_at} + CitizenAckInProgress{actor, incident_id} + TechnicianDispatched{actor, incident_id, technician_id}.

acceptance.criterion: One click fires all 4 events in one transaction
MSW batch handler accepts array payload
Toast confirms "Verified and assigned"

requirement.title: Defer with callback (secondary)
requirement.description: Ghost button "Defer with callback" opens callback-time picker. On confirm, emits IncidentDeferred{actor, incident_id, callback_at}.

acceptance.criterion: Button visible alongside Submit
Click opens callback-time picker
Confirm emits IncidentDeferred with correct payload

requirement.title: Escalate to Pia (secondary)
requirement.description: Ghost button "Escalate to Pia" emits IncidentEscalatedToPha{actor, incident_id}. Routes to placeholder Phase 2 queue.

acceptance.criterion: Button visible alongside Submit and Defer
Click emits IncidentEscalatedToPha with correct payload

requirement.title: Hotline reporter-badge chip on detail header
requirement.description: Detail header shows hotline reporter-badge chip (☎ + reporter-hotline color) when reporter_kind = hotline. Independent of band pill.

acceptance.criterion: Hotline chip renders when reporter_kind = hotline
Hidden when reporter_kind != hotline

requirement.title: Override surface (View override reasoning)
requirement.description: When chain segment contains a TrustBandOverridden event, render "View override reasoning" affordance. Click expands to show the reasoning payload.

acceptance.criterion: Affordance visible when override event in segment
Click expands reasoning payload

requirement.title: Single-click verification reuses chain-verify helper
requirement.description: Inline verify button calls verifyBlock() from web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts (never copy-pasted). Pass badge within 200ms. Per lockdown §7 audit gap.

acceptance.criterion: verifyBlock call goes through helper (verified by import trace)
Pass badge renders within 200ms
Helper never throws (network failure returns VerifyState.fail)

requirement.title: Karim picker + due_at picker + priority override
requirement.description: Render Karim picker (dropdown of field_technicians), due_at picker (DateTime picker), and priority override dropdown (P1/P2/P3/P4). All required for the Submit batch.

acceptance.criterion: All three pickers render in DetailPane
Submit button disabled if Karim or due_at missing

requirement.title: Modal enter/exit 200ms ease-out (foundation §8)
requirement.description: Modal-style elements (callback picker, override expansion, help modal) use 200ms ease-out enter/exit per foundation §8.

acceptance.criterion: Modal animation matches foundation §8 spec

requirement.title: MSW: batch event handler
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts POST /api/events to accept array payload (batch). All four verify+assign events persist via idb-keyval in one write.

acceptance.criterion: POST /api/events with array payload returns 200
All events in batch persist atomically

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: inbox-detail-page, …-header, …-main, …-rail-inbox, …-detail-pane, …-event-chain, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-signal-card-{1..5}, …-photo-viewer, …-map, …-reasoning-path-picker, …-path-{A,B,C,D}, …-reasoning-field-{severity,category,tags,reasoning}, …-karim-picker, …-due-at-picker, …-priority-override, …-button-submit-verify-assign, …-button-defer, …-button-escalate, …-override-reasoning-affordance.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN; no Hindi; hash anchors not translated)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for path picker, reasoning fields, Karim/due_at/priority labels, button labels, toast. EN + BN parity. Trust band + reporter labels localised; hash anchors never translated.

acceptance.criterion: EN + BN key sets match
No Hindi keys present
Hash anchors rendered verbatim (not localised)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Mount /inbox/inc_... as utility_operator; assert column widths 240/flex/360. Three-column proportions correct.
Fill Karim + due_at; select Path A; fill reasoning fields; click Submit; intercept POST /api/events; assert batch of 4 events with correct payloads. 4-event batch fires atomically.
Click inline verify; assert helper import trace; force network failure; assert VerifyState.fail (no throw). Helper reused; never throws.
Click Defer; assert picker opens; pick time; confirm; assert IncidentDeferred event. Defer flow works.
